item.title: Aggregate report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Implement CSV input compatibility and totals per the shared contract. Accept legacy CSV without currency as USD, validate currency codes (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) and exit 2 with stderr error for malformed code. Emit account,currency,total_cents sorted by account then currency. Update README and tests. Run python3 -m unittest and commit the change.

item.title: Add currency field to ledger TSV-to-CSV

Validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed code reports source line number to stderr and exits 2, preserving status 1 for other input errors. Update README and tests. Run cargo test and commit the change.

evidence.caption: Ledger CSV schema before and after: source baseline emitted three columns; the updated CLI emits a fourth currency column and defaults omitted currency to USD.
Malformed currency reports its physical input line and exits 2.

pr.body: Added CurrencyEntry, parse_line_with_currency, and to_csv_row_with_currency while preserving the existing public Entry, parse_line, and to_csv_row APIs. The CLI accepts three or four TSV fields, validates currency as three uppercase ASCII letters, and distinguishes currency errors for exit status 2. Updated README and covered USD fallback, explicit currencies, malformed codes, output, source line reporting, and unchanged status 1 for other input errors. Final checks: cargo fmt -- --check, cargo test (4 integration tests passed), and git diff --check. Baseline source declared date,account,amount_cents and rendered three CSV fields; after sample export emitted date,account,amount_cents,currency with USD and EUR rows.
pr.summary: Added currency-aware ledger input and CSV exports. Before: three TSV fields produced date,account,amount_cents. Now: optional currency defaults to USD and CSV includes currency; malformed currency reports its line and exits 2.
